items.question: What are the names of high schoolers who have 3 or more friends?
items.gold_sql: SELECT T2.name FROM Friend AS T1 JOIN Highschooler AS T2 ON T1.student_id  =  T2.id GROUP BY T1.student_id HAVING count(*)  >=  3

items.question: Show the names of high schoolers who have likes, and numbers of likes for each.
items.gold_sql: SELECT T2.name ,  count(*) FROM Likes AS T1 JOIN Highschooler AS T2 ON T1.student_id  =  T2.id GROUP BY T1.student_id

items.question: Which owner owns the most dogs? List the owner id, first name and last name.
items.gold_sql: SELECT T1.owner_id ,  T2.first_name ,  T2.last_name FROM Dogs AS T1 JOIN Owners AS T2 ON T1.owner_id  =  T2.owner_id GROUP BY T1.owner_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

items.question: Find the id and cell phone of the professionals who operate two or more types of treatments.
items.gold_sql: SELECT T1.professional_id ,  T1.cell_number FROM Professionals AS T1 JOIN Treatments AS T2 ON T1.professional_id  =  T2.professional_id GROUP BY T1.professional_id HAVING count(*)  >=  2

items.question: What are the first name and last name of the professionals who have done treatment with cost below average?
items.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.first_name ,  T1.last_name FROM Professionals AS T1 JOIN Treatments AS T2 WHERE cost_of_treatment  <  ( SELECT avg(cost_of_treatment) FROM Treatments )

items.question: Which dogs are of the rarest breed? Show their names and treatment dates.
items.gold_sql: SELECT T1.name ,  T2.date_of_treatment FROM Dogs AS T1 JOIN Treatments AS T2 ON T1.dog_id  =  T2.dog_id WHERE T1.breed_code  =  ( SELECT breed_code FROM Dogs GROUP BY breed_code ORDER BY count(*) ASC LIMIT 1 )

items.question: List the emails of the professionals who live in the state of Hawaii or the state of Wisconsin.
items.gold_sql: SELECT email_address FROM Professionals WHERE state  =  'Hawaii' OR state  =  'Wisconsin'

items.question: What are the arriving date and the departing date of all the dogs?
items.gold_sql: SELECT date_arrived ,  date_departed FROM Dogs

items.question: Which owners live in the state whose name contains the substring 'North'? List his first name, last name and email.
items.gold_sql: SELECT first_name ,  last_name ,  email_address FROM Owners WHERE state LIKE '%North%'

items.question: Return the first name, last name and email of the owners living in a state whose name contains the substring 'North'.
items.gold_sql: SELECT first_name ,  last_name ,  email_address FROM Owners WHERE state LIKE '%North%'

items.question: Count the number of dogs of an age below the average.
items.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM Dogs WHERE age  <  ( SELECT avg(age) FROM Dogs )

items.question: What are the email, cell phone and home phone of each professional?
items.gold_sql: SELECT email_address ,  cell_number ,  home_phone FROM professionals

items.question: What are the names of singers ordered by ascending net worth?
items.gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM singer ORDER BY Net_Worth_Millions ASC

items.question: What are the birth year and citizenship of singers?
items.gold_sql: SELECT Birth_Year ,  Citizenship FROM singer

items.question: What are the birth years and citizenships of the singers?
items.gold_sql: SELECT Birth_Year ,  Citizenship FROM singer

items.question: What are the names of the singers who are not French citizens?
items.gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM singer WHERE Citizenship != "France"

items.question: What is the name of the singer with the largest net worth?
items.gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM singer ORDER BY Net_Worth_Millions DESC LIMIT 1

items.question: What is the name of the singer who is worth the most?
items.gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM singer ORDER BY Net_Worth_Millions DESC LIMIT 1

items.question: Show different citizenship of singers and the number of singers of each citizenship.
items.gold_sql: SELECT Citizenship ,  COUNT(*) FROM singer GROUP BY Citizenship

items.question: What are the names of the singers that have more than one songs?
items.gold_sql: SELECT T1.Name FROM singer AS T1 JOIN song AS T2 ON T1.Singer_ID  =  T2.Singer_ID GROUP BY T1.Name HAVING COUNT(*)  >  1

items.question: How many available features are there in total?
items.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM Other_Available_Features

items.question: What is the feature type name of feature AirCon?
items.gold_sql: SELECT T2.feature_type_name FROM Other_Available_Features AS T1 JOIN Ref_Feature_Types AS T2 ON T1.feature_type_code  =  T2.feature_type_code WHERE T1.feature_name  =  "AirCon"

items.question: Show the property type descriptions of properties belonging to that code.
items.gold_sql: SELECT T2.property_type_description FROM Properties AS T1 JOIN Ref_Property_Types AS T2 ON T1.property_type_code  =  T2.property_type_code GROUP BY T1.property_type_code

items.question: What are the names of properties that are either houses or apartments with more than 1 room?
items.gold_sql: SELECT property_name FROM Properties WHERE property_type_code  =  "House" UNION SELECT property_name FROM Properties WHERE property_type_code  =  "Apartment" AND room_count  >  1
